name: Industrial Two-Tiered Stainless Steel Service Cart
description: A professional-grade, two-tiered service cart constructed from brushed stainless steel. It features an open frame with vertical bar railings on all sides, two robust flat shelves, and a partial divider on the upper shelf. The unit is equipped with four swivel casters for easy mobility.

name: Minimalist Tapered Concrete Display Pedestal
description: A tall, tapered rectangular pedestal made of light grey concrete, featuring a central rectangular cut-out that runs through its height, creating an open, architectural form. The surface has a raw, matte concrete finish.

name: Ornate Carved Hardwood Elephant Pedestal
description: A highly ornate, richly carved wooden pedestal or column, featuring intricate decorative elements throughout its structure. The base is adorned with multiple elephant heads, while the central shaft showcases delicate floral patterns, lotus motifs, and a carved bell. The capital and plinth are multi-layered with deep relief carvings, presenting a traditional and elaborate aesthetic in a medium brown wood tone.

name: Ornate Carved Wooden Decorative Pedestal
description: An ornate carved wooden pedestal featuring intricate botanical motifs. The pedestal has a hexagonal base from which a central structure rises, flanked by three radiating, multi-tiered elements. Each of these elements is extensively carved with leaf and floral patterns, culminating in a turned finial at the top. The overall design suggests a traditional or exotic aesthetic, with a dark, rich wood finish accentuating the detailed craftsmanship.

name: Ornate Wooden Display Pedestal
description: A tall, traditional wooden pedestal featuring a dark brown finish. It has a square top surface, a rounded, turned capital below the top, a smooth cylindrical shaft, and a square, heavily carved base. The base includes recessed panels adorned with concentric rosette carvings, flanked by small pilasters or columns.

name: Modern Chrome and Glass Serving Cart
description: A sleek, two-tiered serving cart featuring a polished chrome tubular frame and glass shelves. The top shelf is a smoked or tinted glass, while the bottom shelf is clear glass with a chrome wire rack on one side. The cart is equipped with four swivel caster wheels for easy mobility.

name: Industrial Style Hall Tree with Bench and Coat Hooks
description: An industrial-style hall tree featuring a light wood-toned bench, a matching top shelf, and a series of five black metal coat hooks, all integrated into a sturdy black metal frame. The design is minimalist and functional, intended for an entryway or mudroom.

name: Drop-leaf Wooden Serving Cart with Glass Top
description: A traditional wooden serving cart featuring a drop-leaf top with a glass insert, supported by turned legs, and equipped with both large spoked wheels and small caster wheels for mobility. It includes a lower storage shelf.
